title: Assessing IREN (IREN) Valuation After Strong Earnings And Volatile Share Price Performance
text: IREN (IREN) has drawn attention after reporting annual revenue of US$688.554 million and net income of US$523.255 million, with investors weighing these figures against recent share price swings over the month and the past 3 months.
